pressure_observation: Static pressure shows high values at the inlet and decreases smoothly through the converging section, reaching lower values in the divergent section.

velocity_observation: Velocity magnitude mirrors the Mach number distribution, starting low at the inlet and increasing significantly toward the exit of the nozzle.
